subject: Veridian Health: runtime handshake + schema sprint (streaming, toolcalls, structured output)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Gupta <asha@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Veridian Health: runtime handshake + schema sprint (streaming, toolcalls, structured output)

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, I want to outline a tight 2-week sprint to get Veridian moved from pilot to feature-enabled in production for the real-time patient-summary flow (streaming + function/tool calling + structured JSON outputs). Goal: first production-quality schema and canary on staging by the end of sprint 2.

High-level plan (proposed):
- Week 1: schema alignment, tooling hooks (function contracts), and sample payloads
- Week 2: runtime wiring (streaming connectors, KV prefix caching), canary rollout and perf smoke tests

Requested from Veridian this week:
1) Primary integration contact for engineering (email + Slack)
2) Example patient event payloads (anonymized) and the top 12 acceptance fields for the summary JSON
3) Any hard latency SLOs we should honor for the initial canary

I've attached an implementation_checklist.xlsx and a lightweight schema_examples.json to seed the conversation. Monica will lead schema mapping; Rishi will own runtime tuning and batching configuration.

Next best step: propose 60-minute kickoff with Eng + CS + Veridian integrations on Monday (07/22). Is 10am PT okay?

Thanks —

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: implementation_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: schema_examples.json (text/json stub)

From: Asha Gupta <asha@veridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Veridian Health Integrations <integrations@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2024 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Veridian Health: runtime handshake + schema sprint (streaming, toolcalls, structured output)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks, this looks good. Confirming our integration lead will be me and I will add Daniel (backend) and Priya (security) to the thread tomorrow once I have them. 10am PT on Monday works on our side.

A couple of notes up front:
- Our latency goal for the summary API is p95 < 250ms for <512 token responses; if Redwood’s batching impacts this we’ll need clear fallbacks.
- We will provide two months of anonymized event samples by EOD Friday. Expect some schema variants across our producers; the mapping step will be important.

I’ll upload the payloads to the Drive link you shared and send the access to Daniel.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Gupta
Director, Integrations — Veridian Health
asha@veridianhealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Gupta <asha@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2024 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Veridian Health: runtime handshake + schema sprint (streaming, toolcalls, structured output)

Thanks Asha. Quick sketch of the schema work I’ll run during Week 1:
- Day 1: ingest sample payloads, identify top-level field variants, produce a canonical summary schema (JSON Schema + example fixtures)
- Day 2–3: field mapping doc with fallback rules (e.g., prefer patient.display_name, else {first_name,last_name})
- Day 4: validation hooks and test vectors for the runtime team

Questions for Veridian (quick):
1) Do you have a single canonical patient_id across producers or should we expect multiple IDs to be crosswalked?
2) Are there PII redaction rules we should apply pre-serve? Priya from your team can confirm.

I’ll prototype a draft schema_examples.json enhancement and attach it to the drive by EOD Sunday so Daniel can review Monday morning.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_v1.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@veridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Asha Gupta <asha@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2024 09:01:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Veridian Health: runtime handshake + schema sprint (streaming, toolcalls, structured output)

Thanks team —

We reviewed the sample payloads overnight. A few immediate items:
- We do have two producer systems (EPIC stream + mobile app) and patient identifiers differ; we will provide a crosswalk table.
- Priya (copied on separate email) confirmed initial redaction rules; she asked for a list of fields we plan to surface in the summary.

We’re good for the 10am PT kickoff. Sending calendar invite now.

—Daniel
Daniel Ortiz
Senior Backend Engineer, Veridian Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@veridianhealth.com>, Asha Gupta <asha@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2024 12:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Veridian Health: runtime handshake + schema sprint (streaming, toolcalls, structured output)

Appreciate the samples, Daniel. A couple notes from the runtime side before the kickoff:
- Batching: we’ll start with conservative batching (max latency budget 40ms) and tune by producer after canary. If any of your producers send very short sequences we may skip batching to meet p95 targets.
- Function/tool calling: please confirm the list of callable actions we should expose (e.g., fetch_med_history, fetch_recent_visits). If you can provide the OpenAPI-like stubs or a table of inputs/outputs that’ll speed integration.
- KV cache: we’ll recommend prefix caching for common patient-context tokens; need guidance on TTL expectations per patient session.

I attached a short runtime checklist to the invite. Looking forward to the call.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Engineer, Runtime, Redwood Inference
Attachment: runtime_checklist.txt (text stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: AllRecipients <all@veridian-internal.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2024 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Veridian Health: runtime handshake + schema sprint (streaming, toolcalls, structured output)

Thanks everyone — great kickoff. Quick follow-ups and agreed owners: 
- Veridian: supply crosswalk CSV (Daniel) and redaction confirmation (Priya) by Wed EOD
- Monica: deliver canonical JSON Schema + validation harness by Wed (links in Drive)
- Rishi: prototype batching config + function stubs for fetch_med_history/fetch_recent_visits by Thu
- Kimberly (CS): coordinate canary window and rollback criteria; I’ll share a one-pager for the execs by Friday

I’ve uploaded updated schema_examples.json (v2) and implementation_checklist.xlsx to the Drive folder and linked in the HubSpot deal. DocuSign SOW sent for signature (link above).

If anything changes, flag in the thread. Otherwise we’ll reconvene Friday for a short sync.

Best,
Kimberly
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: schema_examples.json (updated)
